featured_reviews.name: DHRUV Jethwa
featured_reviews.review_text:
Learning how to drive and appearing for a driving test is a major milestone in a person’s life. It is not just about controlling a vehicle, but about understanding road safety, traffic rules, responsibility, and discipline. My driving test experience was both challenging and educational. It tested not only my driving skills but also my patience, confidence, and ability to remain calm under pressure. This review reflects my complete journey—from preparation to the final result—highlighting what I learned, what went well, and what could be improved in the driving test system.
Importance of the Driving Test
The driving test plays a crucial role in ensuring road safety. Roads are shared by vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, and animals, especially in countries like India where traffic conditions are complex. A driving license is not just a document; it is proof that a person is capable of driving responsibly. The driving test aims to evaluate whether a candidate has sufficient knowledge of traffic rules, control over the vehicle, awareness of surroundings, and the right attitude toward road safety.
Without a proper driving test, untrained drivers could pose a serious risk to others. Therefore, the driving test acts as a filter that ensures only skilled and responsible individuals are allowed to drive on public roads.
Preparation for the Driving Test
Preparation for the driving test began several weeks before the actual test date. It included both theoretical knowledge and practical driving skills.
Learning Traffic Rules
The first step was understanding traffic rules and road signs. I studied topics such as:
Traffic signals and their meanings
Road signs like mandatory, cautionary, and informatory signs
Speed limits for different roads
Rules for overtaking and lane discipline
Right of way at intersections
Use of indicators, headlights, and horn
This theoretical knowledge was essential because many mistakes during the test occur due to lack of awareness of rules rather than poor driving skills.
Practical Driving Practice
Practical driving practice was the most important part of preparation. I practiced driving regularly under different conditions:
Narrow roads
Busy traffic areas
Turns and U-turns
Reverse driving
Parking techniques
Special attention was given to clutch control, braking smoothly, and steering control. Initially, it was difficult to manage everything at once, but consistent practice helped build confidence.
Test Day Experience
The day of the driving test was filled with nervousness and excitement. Reaching the test center early helped me stay calm and prepared. The test center was crowded with many candidates, each waiting for their turn. Observing others before my test helped me understand the test procedure better.
The officials at the test center were professional but strict. Their seriousness made it clear that the test should not be taken lightly. After document verification, my name was called, and I was asked to bring the vehicle to the test track.
Driving Test Procedure
The driving test consisted of multiple stages designed to evaluate different driving skills.
Vehicle Inspection
Before starting the test, I was asked basic questions related to the vehicle:
Brake and clutch function
Indicator and headlight operation
Horn usage
This step ensured that the driver knows basic vehicle controls and safety features.
Track Test
